title: Modular Inference Knobs: Rollout Cadence & Initiative Tracker
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: deliver a staged rollout and initiative tracker for a set of modular inference knobs (adaptive batching profiles, prefix/KV caching policies, and optional micro-quantization bundles) to reduce per-token cost by 15–25% across non-SLA and best-effort routes while keeping p95 latency degradation < 10%. This ticket coordinates PM workstreams: hypothesis catalog, validation harness, canary schedule, metrics/guardrails, and rollout comms. Deliverables: experiment matrix, evaluation dashboards, rollout playbook with abort conditions, and customer-facing docs for opt-in economy mode.
comments: 2026-01-20 Aisha Patel: Created initiative ticket to centralize rollout cadence after Q4 field trials. Initial hypotheses attached in the drive doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/KNOBS-Playbook (read-only).

2026-02-02 Liam O'Connell: ENG sync — agreed to prototype two adaptive batching profiles (latency-first and throughput-first). ENG will surface a performance test harness by 2026-02-18. Assigned ENG-3412 / ENG-4038 for infra changes.

2026-02-11 Research note (Maya Chen): Early lab runs show quantization bundle Q3 reduces GPU memory by ~22% and token throughput cost by ~18% for Llama-like 8B variants, but increases CPU offload risk on autoscaling events. Recommend gating Q3 to Dedicated and Best-Effort Hosted only.

2026-02-19 Liam O'Connell: PR opened for batching scheduler changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7654 — awaiting perf baseline and trace asserts. Added unit tests around latency SLO enforcement.

2026-02-28 Aisha Patel: Decided rollout plan: 1) internal smoke (canary on staging), 2) 5% of opt-in customers (non-SLA), 3) 25% ramp contingent on cost delta and error metrics, 4) full availability. Abort conditions defined in playbook: >5% error rate increase or >10% p95 latency regression for 15m window.

2026-03-04 Ops note (Jordan Kim): Observability hooks required: per-route token cost/time breakdown, quantized vs baseline quality regression metric, and KV cache hit-rate heatmap. Linking draft dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/knobs-rollout

2026-03-08 QA (Samira Gomez): Created test suite for output-quality regression with 120 prompt seeds across genres. Initial runs show negligible semantic drift for batching-only profile; quantization trials require additional prompt normalization to avoid hallucination noise.

2026-03-12 Aisha Patel: Updated initiative tracker with cycle goals and OKRs. OKR: reduce hosted per-token spend by 12% in Q2 attributable to opt-in economy mode with <0.5% rollback rate. Next steps: finalize customer comms, schedule first 5% canary on 2026-03-22, and lock experiments dashboard alerts.
notes: Trade-offs: immediate cost wins (batching + cache TTL tuning) are low-risk and should be prioritized for early customers. Micro-quantization delivers stronger savings but has higher quality variance and operational lift (rollback/compatibility). We will treat quantization bundles as gated features with opt-in flags and require a post-rollout quality sweep before expanding to SLA-backed routes. Communication: prepare a brief for Solutions Engineering and CS with technical FAQ and recommended customer profiles for early opt-in.
rollout_plan:
1) Staging smoke tests (2026-03-15 to 2026-03-18)
2) Canary: 5% opt-in customers, non-SLA routes (2026-03-22 to 2026-03-29)
3) Ramp to 25% if cost delta >=10% and quality regressions <0.3% (2026-03-30 to 2026-04-12)
4) General opt-in availability & docs (target 2026-04-15).
metrics_targets: Cost delta: >=12% per-token on opt-in population; Latency p95 impact: <10% relative; Error rate delta: <0.5%; Quality regressions (eval-suite): <0.3%.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: quantization-induced hallucination spikes — Mitigation: keep quantization opt-in, add prompt-normalization preprocessor, and require manual QA sign-off. Risk: autoscaler interaction causes CPU thrashing — Mitigation: add scaling cooldowns and per-node resource limits in ENG-4038. Risk: customer confusion — Mitigation: clear docs and label feature as 'Economy Mode' with explicit trade-offs.
communication_actions: Draft customer announcement, solutions engineering runbook, and internal postmortem template. Owner: Aisha Patel. Target send date for early adopters: 2026-03-20.
